# HR-V0 arm-interface source register

**PRELIMINARY—CANDIDATE SOURCES ONLY—NOT RELEASED FOR PROCUREMENT, FABRICATION, OR ENERGIZATION**

`arm-interface-source-register.csv` records the exact current primary pages used by R57. A product page establishes only the cited candidate identity and published dimensions. It does not release a purchase, certify received hardware, establish an installation torque, create a material allowable, or prove the assembled joint.

OnlineMetals part `1249` is the exact raw-stock candidate, but purchase is still held. One heat lot and an MTR are mandatory, and the received certificate must meet the project acceptance requirements. OnlineMetals and Kaiser reference values are screening inputs, not design allowables. Supplier DFM, received dimensions, application calculations, physical proof and qualified disposition remain mandatory.
